research_result.description: Snowflake is a data cloud platform offering REST APIs, SQL APIs, and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration to manage infrastructure, run queries, and build AI-agent workflows.
research_result.credential_requirements: Access requires a Snowflake account, which can be created via a free trial or paid subscription. Developers generate credentials such as OAuth access tokens, programmatic access tokens (PATs), or key-pair JWT tokens.

evidence.claim: Snowflake offers native MCP server support to serve Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, SQL execution, and custom tools to AI agents.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Snowflake-managed MCP server lets AI agents securely retrieve data from Snowflake accounts without needing to deploy separate infrastructure.

evidence.claim: Snowflake supports OAuth 2.0 protocol for API authentication and authorization.

evidence.claim: Snowflake provides a broad REST API surface covering database resources, compute warehouses, data loading, AI/ML tools, and security management.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The %sf-rest% suite of APIs enables developers to build end-to-end automation and integration with Snowflake resources.
